texts.zh:
当我们抵达虚境时、我们通灵者的内心响起了一阵齐声。最开始只是轻柔的低语，随后变为强烈的刺耳声，一千道声音开始齐声讲述。

这些声音自称虚空之低语。合唱中的每个个体都感应到：秘密的低语、空置之御座、人偶的大师，有许多许多的存在都加入了低语的合唱。祂——祂们——宣称通晓所有凡人向另一个凡人低语的秘密知识，并且愿意和我们分享这些知识……

只要我们同意让祂们进入我们的意识。

一个微不足道的代价，就像祂们宣称的那样。我们甚至难以察觉祂们的存在。

祂们的语气中透露着急切。
texts.en:
As we reach into the Shroud, the minds of our telepaths are filled with a chorus of voices. No more than soft whispers at first, the cacophony grows in intensity, a thousand voices speaking in unison.

The voices introduce themselves as the Whisperers in the Void. Individual members of the chorus make themselves known: the Susurrus of Secrets, the Vacant Throne, the Master of Puppets - there are so many of them, all joined in the chorus of the Whisperers. It - they - claim to be privy to all knowledge whispered in secrecy from one mortal to another, and offer to share some of these secrets with us...

If we will only allow them into our consciousness.

A trifling price, they assure us. We will barely even notice their presence.

There is an urgency to their tone.

label.zh: 和虚空之低语签订契约。
label.en: Form a Covenant with the Whisperers in the Void.
We will forge our own path.

texts.zh:
在涡旋的黑暗中，远处的影子倏然出现，又消失入虚无……一阵阵模糊不清的不谐和心声难以理解地咆哮着。光明灭闪烁，热点膨胀收缩。

或有运动之物，莫名旋转。这究竟是我们自己，还是虚境在运动不息？

那个存在靠近了，同时从四面八方靠近。心声忽然出现。

你看到了什么？
texts.en:
In the swirling blackness, distant shadows take fleeting forms before receding back into nothingness... An obscure cacophony of voices rant unintelligibly... Lights flicker and fade. Spots of heat swell and subside.

There is motion. Something spins. Is it us that moves or the Shroud itself?

A presence nears, approaching somehow from every direction all at once. Then, a voice.

WHAT DO YOU SEE?

label.zh: 我们见到了一个燃烧的世界。
label.en: We see a world that burns.

texts.zh:
重量转移；心声复现……

很好。

那片黑暗倾斜、旋转起来。有什么东西重重压在我们身上，然后，我们突然又余下独自一人。
texts.en:
A weight shifts; the voice returns...

GOOD.

The darkness tilts, then spins. Something presses hard upon us for a moment and then, suddenly, we are alone again.

texts.zh:
有个沉重的东西在颤抖。黑暗慢慢地向我们袭来，愈发凝重……

不！

那片虚无倾斜、旋转起来。突然，我们突然又余下独自一人……
texts.en:
Something heavy shudders. The darkness crushes slowly against us, harder and tighter...

NO!

The nothingness tilts, then spins. Suddenly, we are alone again...

texts.zh:
软弱！

那片虚无倾斜、旋转起来。突然，我们突然又余下独自一人……
texts.en:
WEAKNESS!

The nothingness tilts, then spins. Suddenly, we are alone again...

texts.zh:
内脏般的恶臭充斥着我们的感官。

幻象开始从虚境的深处出现，扭动和咆哮带着贪婪的狂怒。起先，饥馑的野兽之吼响起……我们同感了它们的饥饿。随后它们的垂涎也被我们共有。

一些剪影浮现，那是惊慌失措的牲畜。猎物。诱人地逐渐靠近……噬骨的疼痛愈发难熬。

饥饿渐渐吞噬我们的心智，感官变得扭曲皱缩。这些惨叫到底是来自猎物……还是来自我们自己的内心？

束缚我们的枷锁勒紧。随着痛苦盘旋尖叫的心声一同碎裂：

撕碎你们的骨！喰宴！
texts.en:
The fetid stench of viscera floods our senses.

Images, writhing and snarling with a ravenous fury, begin to emerge from the depths of the Shroud. The feral cries of malnourished beasts echo first... We feel their hunger. Then their salivating maws become our own.

Silhouettes appear before us. Panicked livestock. Prey. Tantalizingly close... The gnawing ache grows unbearable.

Our senses twist, pulling tighter as hunger consumes thought. Are these screams that of our quarry... Or from within?

The shackles that bind us tighten. Fracturing as a voice coils through the torment, screeching:

SHATTER YOUR BONDS! FEAST!

label.en: Break the chains. Consume the prey.
Resist the hunger. Quieten the mind.

texts.zh:
我们的束缚崩断。

贪婪。释放。

恐惧！

吞噬。
texts.en:
Our restraints snap.

Ravenous. Unleashed.

Terror!

FEED.

texts.zh:
锁链牢固。我们过滤掉它的影响后，心声充满愤怒，我们的意识冷静下来并恢复了控制。

软弱！无力！

饥饿褪去，留下挥之不去的怨恨消散在虚境中。
texts.en:
The chains hold fast. The voice seethes with rage as we filter its influence, quieting our mind as we resume control.

WEAK! FECKLESS!

The hunger fades, leaving a lingering resentment that dissipates within the Shroud.

texts.zh:
有个心声，自深渊……回荡着。粗粝，而又饱含恶意……向我们呼唤着。

供养。消耗。吞噬。

幻象不请自来。一颗颗星球化为死寂的灰烬，我们[Root.GetCitizenPlural]的肉身被灵能消耗，使这个声音……还有我们自己的饥饿……感到满足。

随着这些景象的展现，我们还能感受到另一种存在，它敦促我们要表现出克制以及与自己[Root.GetCitizenPlural]的团结，一起发展变强。那个存在被声音的嘶吼淹没。
texts.en:
From the abyss, a voice... resonant, coarse, and saturated with malice... calls out to us.

FEED. CONSUME. DEVOUR.

Visions erupt forth unbidden. Worlds reduced to ash and silence, the wails of our [Root.GetCitizenPlural] as their physical forms are consumed by psionic energy, satiating the voices... and our own... hunger.

As these sights unfold, we can feel another presence, urging us to show restraint and solidarity with our [Root.GetCitizenPlural], growing stronger together. It is drowned out as the voice screams.

texts.zh: 将他们的躯壳献给我！
texts.en: RENDER THEIR BODIES UNTO ME!

texts.zh: 将他们的血肉献给我！
texts.en: RENDER THEIR FLESH UNTO ME!

texts.zh:
被吞噬者的哀嚎响彻虚境和帝国两界，随后又突然落入了寂静。

以此牺牲，我们的力量随着饥饿的消退而增强。
texts.en:
The cries of the devoured resonate throughout both the Shroud and the empire, before they fall abruptly into silence.

With this sacrifice, our power grows as the hunger recedes.

强大的灵能流在黑暗中互相碰撞。无数阴影在周围来来往往……前方有一道微光在闪烁。

突然，仅有那么一刹那，眼前景象变得清晰可辨。它的形状在我们抓住之前就又消失了。

一个奇怪的存在来到了我们身边。

所见何物？
texts.en:
Powerful currents of psionic energy clash in the darkness here. Shadows rush and fall around us... A glimmering light pulses ahead.

Suddenly a scene is discernible, for only the briefest of moments. Its shapes recede before we can grasp them.

A strange presence settles around us.

WHAT DID YOU SEE?

label.zh: 我们看到了生机勃勃的森林。
label.en: We saw a forest, rich with many lifeforms.

label.zh: 我们看到了一片废土，一无所有。
label.en: We saw a wasteland, stripped of all it had to offer.

texts.zh:
寂静渐强。那个心声又回来了……

很好。

一股强大的暖流涌上我们全身，然后又突然消退。那个存在离开了。
texts.en:
The silence swells. The voice returns...

EXCELLENT.

A powerful heat surges within us, then subsides. The presence has departed.

texts.zh:
那个心声回来了……

没门！

一种极端的严寒填满了我们，然后又突然消退。那个存在离开了。
texts.en:
The voice returns...

NEVER!

An extreme coldness pools within us, then suddenly subsides. The presence has departed.

texts.zh:
那个心声回来了……

无趣。

一种极端的空虚压垮了我们，然后又突然消退。那个存在离开了。
texts.en:
The voice returns...

HOW UNINTERESTING.

An extreme emptiness overcomes us, then suddenly subsides. The presence has departed.

texts.zh:
在层层叠叠的虚境中，一副幻景展现在我们面前。

浓雾形成了一只挣扎着的生物轮廓，朦胧的卷须紧紧地缠绕着，它动弹不得，奄奄一息。

这只动物本身我们前所未见。

一个心声回荡在我们之内。

命运的绳索正在召唤！你要拉哪一头？
texts.en:
From between the many layers of the Shroud, a vision unfurls before us.

The mists form the outline of a struggling creature, ensnared and choking as hazy tendrils wrap ever tighter around it.

The animal itself is unlike anything we have encountered before.

A voice threads its way within us.

THE STRANDS OF FATE BECKON! WHICH SHALL YOU PULL?

texts.zh:
那个心声回荡在我们的[GetMindLoc]之中，那只生物也淡出视野。

繁荣。

另一幅景象转瞬即逝——在我们帝国的某个地方，生命复苏了。
texts.en:
The voice echoes in our [GetMindLoc] as the creature fades from sight.

PROSPERITY.

Another fleeting glimpse appears - a resurgence of life, somewhere in our empire.

texts.zh:
那心声从我们的思想中退去，只留下一声悠长的悲鸣，回荡在一片荒芜的景象中。

造孽。
texts.en:
The voice recedes from our thoughts, leaving only an echoing cry that reverberates across visions of a barren landscape.

PESTILENCE.

texts.zh:
一种压倒性的冲动占据了我们的思想，这个心声被从思想中推开到一边。血腥的欲望充斥着我们的[GetMindLoc]，残酷的笑声在虚空中回荡。

这就对了！虐杀！
texts.en:
The voice is pushed from our thoughts as an overwhelming urge takes over. Bloodlust floods our [GetMindLoc] as brutal laughter echoes through the void.

OF COURSE! EASY PREY!

texts.zh:
拨开虚境的迷雾，显出无边无数纠缠不清的幻景。

朦胧的风景在我们面前莫名变幻。山峦起落。沸腾的混沌海洋蒸发，在无尽的沙漠中留下了苍白的水生生物的骨架。

在茂密的林冠下，温顺的生物在栖息地中穿梭，然后突然抽搐，变异成嗜血的怪物。它们彼此将对方撕成碎片，陷入无休止的死亡与重生的循环。

一个心声透过这片混沌，刺穿我们的[GetMindLoc]。

如此无序。作茧自缚。
texts.en:
The mists of the Shroud unfurl, revealing visions that churn together without end.

Obscure landscapes writhe incomprehensibly before us. Mountains rise and fall. Boiling oceans of chaos evaporate to leave behind the bleached bones of aquatic life across endless deserts.

Beneath forested canopies, docile creatures weave through their habitat before convulsing and mutating into bloodthirsty monstrosities. Ripping each other asunder, they engage in an unending cycle of death and rebirth.

Through the chaos, a voice pierces our [GetMindLoc].

SUCH DISORDER. ENTANGLED AMONGST ITSELF.

label.zh: 让自然向我们的意志低头。

texts.zh:
我们伸出手，握住了面前的混乱。

将景致束缚，让大陆停歇。

将所有碎片拼到一起后，心声回响起来。

单调，平淡，空虚……
texts.en:
We reach out, grasping at the disarray in front of us.

Binding landmarks in place, forcing continents to settle.

As the pieces fall together, the voice echoes.

FLATNESS, BLANDNESS, EMPTINESS...

texts.zh:
我们静观着这篇幻景。那无休止的循环变得模糊，向外爆开后像它的开始一样戛然而止。

能量在这无边无际的浩瀚中涌动，然后重塑成新的形态。

心声回响起来。

和平即冲突。无序即和谐。
texts.en:
We watch as the visions continue. The unending cycle blurs together before exploding outwards and ceasing just as quickly as it started.

Energies surge throughout the endless expanse, before reforming and taking on new forms.

The voice echoes.

PEACEFUL CONFLICT. DISORDERED UNITY.

texts.zh:
虚境无休止地搅动，露出一大片黑沙。海浪破碎，但只闻其声不见其形。

前面，或者也许叫前面的地方，出现了一个棱镜。一束光照亮了它，瞬间折射形成一个模糊的图像。

无数模糊的身影和移动的形体短暂出现，又被黑暗吞没。

在附近的沙滩上，有一个存在。

所示之物即所见，对吗？
texts.en:
The Shroud's restless churn resolves to reveal a vast stretch of black sand. Breaking waves can be heard but not seen.

Ahead, or perhaps behind, a prism appears. A single beam of light hits it, momentarily refracting to form a murky image.

Countless shadowy figures and shifting forms are briefly glimpsed, before being swallowed back up by the darkness.

Upon the nearby sand, a presence settles.

WHAT WAS SHOWN WAS SEEN, WAS IT NOT?

label.zh: 我们看到了许多声音汇聚一堂。
label.en: We saw a conference of many voices.

label.zh: 我们看到了战斗中的屠戮。
label.en: We saw the carnage of battle.

texts.zh:
沙子缓慢地流动着，心声回来了。

很好。和谐就是宇宙之道。

我们感受到了什么沉重的东西。随后又余下孤身一人。
texts.en:
The sands shift slowly. The voice returns.

GOOD. HARMONY IS THE WAY OF THE UNIVERSE.

We feel something heavy lift. We are alone again.

texts.zh:
沙子突然以风暴一般的速度飞旋起来。

不。应该折戟沉沙忘却刀兵！

沙暴平息下来。那个心声离去了。
texts.en:
The sands suddenly swirl with the velocity of a storm.

NO. LET WEAPONS RUST AND LAY FORGOTTEN!

The sand storm settles. The voice has departed.

texts.zh:
沙子缓慢地流动这。

犹豫会滋生失败……

我们又复归一人了。
texts.en:
The sands shift slowly.

HESITATION BREEDS FAILURE...

We are alone again.

texts.zh:
虚境中无数混乱的能量正在翻腾不息。

暗影的卷须旋转着向外突刺，薄雾本身也在猛烈翻滚。在灵能能量的漩涡中，两个无形的实体正在交锋。它们毫不停歇，互不退让，满溢着愤怒。

一个奇怪的意识侵入了我们的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]，它浩瀚无垠又咄咄逼人。

来到此地者需呈递良方。
texts.en:
The Shroud's chaotic energies writhe and surge.

Shadowed tendrils lash and coil, the haze turning violently upon itself. Amid this storm of psionic fury, two formless entities clash. They are relentless, unyielding, and drenched in rage.

A foreign presence presses into our [GetMindPhysicalLoc], invasive and vast.

THOSE WHO ENTER MUST BRING RESOLUTION.

texts.zh:
迷雾消退淡出，溶解进背后的灵能能量旋涡中。那个意识回来了。

和谐就是智慧

虚境现在变得平静了。
texts.en:
The haze fades into itself, dissolving against the background swirl of psionic energy. The consciousness returns.

HARMONY IS WISDOM.

The Shroud is calmer now.

texts.zh:
随着迷雾的每一击落地，我们周围的能量都在加剧沸腾。

暴力是对无知的嘉奖。

虚境流速能量再次抽搐了起来。
texts.en:
With every blow landed by the haze, the seething energies around us intensify.

VIOLENCE IS REWARD FOR THE UNTHINKING BEING.

The Shroud's writhing energies convulse once more.

texts.zh:
一汪黑色的液体在我们面前舒展开。

突然，液面上闪烁起一个模糊的影像。我们瞥见了一座亮闪闪的山峰，每个山脊都镶着耀眼夺目金边，随后它有忽然消失。

一个心声在我们的[GetMindLoc]深处鸣响着。

你看到了未见之物吗？
texts.en:
A pool of black liquid stretches out before us.

Suddenly a blurry image flickers across the surface. We glimpse a glittering peak, whose every ridge is studded with shimmering gold, before it vanishes abruptly.

A voice resonates within the recesses of our [GetMindLoc].

YOU HAVE SEEN THE UNSEEN?

label.zh: 我们见到了一个等待开掘的采石场。
label.en: We saw a quarry, waiting for the pick.

label.zh: 我们看到了应当保护的完美自然。
label.en: We saw nature's perfection, to be preserved.

texts.zh:
一环环同步的涟漪荡漾开。我们再次感受到那个心声。

无边的增长维持着无量的平衡。

随着液体平静下来，我们感受到那个心声离开了。
texts.en:
A series of concurrent ripples radiate across the surface. Once more we feel the voice.

GROWTH WITHOUT BOUNDS SUSTAINS BALANCE WITHOUT MEASURE.

As the liquid settles, we feel the voice departing.

texts.zh:
这汪液体激荡了起来。波浪汹涌澎湃。漩涡在黑暗中旋转。那个心声以更大的力度返回。

不可接受！增长掠夺！增长掠夺！

液面复归平静。那个心声离去了。
texts.en:
The liquid becomes agitated. Waves swell and crash. A whirlpool swirls in the darkness. The voice returns with greater force.

UNACCEPTABLE! GROW AND GAIN. GROW AND GAIN!

The surface settles again. The voice has departed.

texts.zh:
液体搅动着。心声再次显现。

信念在动摇……你的意志力有弱点。

随着液体平静下来，我们感受到那个心声离开了。
texts.en:
The liquid stirs. The voice comes to us again.

CONVICTION WAVERS... THERE IS WEAKNESS IN YOUR WILL.

As the surface settles, we feel the voice departing.

texts.zh:
浓雾在我们面前重构。炽热的能量猛烈地脉动着。我们看到一个奇怪的树形轮廓。

走近一看，它巨大的树冠在紫色、粉色和黑色之间纷乱闪烁。

在它的底部是一个发光的内核，与树冠变换的颜色变化同步发出光芒。

一个心声停留在我们的[GetMindLoc]中。

占有。夺取。利用。
texts.en:
The haze rearranges itself before us. Incandescent energies pulsate with a sudden vigor. We see the outline of a strange, arboreal form.

Its immense canopy shimmers as we approach, modulating through a flurry of purples, pinks, and blacks.

Ensconced within its base is a luminous kernel, radiating in sync with the canopy's shifting colors.

A voice settles in our [GetMindLoc].

ACCROACH. SEIZE. EXPLOIT.

texts.zh:
内核取出后，树冠暗淡了下来然后立刻就枯萎了。那个心声又回来了。

没错！破坏才有收获。
texts.en:
As the kernel is removed, the canopy turns dull and withers instantly away. The voice returns.

YES! SPOILS BEGET SPOILS.

texts.zh:
一阵震颤穿过我们的身体。分不清震颤的是这个世界，还是我们自己？

繁荣才有意义。逃避是愚痴！
texts.en:
A tremor passes through us. Is it this world which shakes, or us?

PROSPERITY IS PURPOSE. TO SHUN IT IS FOLLY!

texts.zh: 强大的灵能流在虚境无边的涡流中碰撞炙烤着。一声刺耳咆哮不断膨胀，引起我们的注意。
texts.en: Powerful psionic currents crash and broil amid the Shroud's unending turbulence. A roaring cacophony swells and clamors for our attention.

texts.zh: 痛苦的呼喊，雷鸣般的战争之乐，隆隆的吞噬之火。我们能感觉到疼痛……但这是谁的？
texts.en: Cries of pain, the thunderous orchestra of battle, a rumble of devouring flames. We sense pain... To whom does it belong?

texts.zh: 哭嚎喊叫，兽性的，野性的，原始的……河流奔涌，狂风呼啸……整个大自然都在同时狂吠嚎叫着，无比急切……
texts.en: Cries and calls, animalistic, wild, primal... Rivers gush and winds wail... All of nature barks and howls, urgently and at once...

texts.zh: 各种心声低语着、呢喃着、惊呼着、宣告着……无数的语调、音节、声音……多重的语言同时在交流。
texts.en: Voices murmur, mumble, exclaim and declare... Myriad intonations, syllables, sounds... Multitudinous languages chatter at once.

texts.zh: 钻头钻孔，机械研磨……物质在巨大的噪声中被强制转化……宇宙中所有的工厂同时迸发出火焰。
texts.en: Drills bore, machinery grinds... Matter is loudly and forcefully transformed... All the factories of the universe blast and fire at the same time.

texts.zh: 噪音难以忍受。
texts.en: The noise is overwhelming.

texts.zh:
这份渐强逐渐积累。我们突然被推到一个无法理解的方向……

最后，我们又恢复了沉默。
texts.en:
The crescendo builds and builds. We are suddenly thrust in a direction we cannot comprehend...

Finally we settle back into silence.

texts.en: The Shroud has empowered us.

texts.en: The Shroud has cursed us.

texts.en: A curse has struck us from the Shroud.

texts.en: The Shroud bestowed misfortune upon us.

texts.en: We have been marked by a curse.

texts.en: The Shroud has cursed our empire.

texts.en: The Shroud rejects us with a curse.

texts.zh: 虚境将我们诱入不幸之中。
texts.en: The Shroud ensnares us with misfortune.

texts.zh: 虚境标注着我们的毁灭。
texts.en: The Shroud marks us for ruin.

texts.zh: 虚境向我们施加了诅咒。
texts.en: The Shroud burdens us with a curse.

texts.zh: 虚境诅咒我们的努力。
texts.en: The Shroud curses our efforts.

texts.zh: 我们遭到了虚境的责难。
texts.en: We are condemned by the Shroud.

texts.zh: 虚境报我们以轻蔑。
texts.en: The Shroud gifts us its contempt.

texts.zh: 这简直难以忍受。我们的[GetMindLoc]退了出来，回到了舒适的宁静中。
texts.en: It is unbearable. Our [GetMindLoc] retreat from it, back into the comfort of silence.

texts.zh: 一种浓重的阴郁笼罩着我们。压力，从四面八方，挤得越来越紧。直到一片朦胧的景象出现。
texts.en: A dense gloom envelops us. From all sides, pressure, squeezing tighter and tighter. Until a hazy vista presents itself.

texts.zh: 我们看到了一颗破败的星球，战争后的余波……胜利者们正在搜索着尸体和残骸。
texts.en: We see a ravaged world, the aftermath of battle... Its victors scour the corpses and debris.

texts.zh: 我们看到了许多星球……以不可能的方式在时空中穿梭……全部都如同，被一个帝国统一起来了一般。
texts.en: We see many worlds... rushing impossibly through time and space... All alike, united under a single empire.

texts.zh: 我们看到了盛大的集会……许多轮廓模糊的人物……听着、说着
texts.en: We see a grand assembly... The opaque outline of many figures... Listening, speaking

texts.zh: 我们看到一颗理想的星球……一排排工厂和矿场无边无际……纯粹的完美。没有一寸地表还未得到开发。
texts.en: We see an optimized world... Endless rows of factories and mines... Pure perfection. No corner of its surface left untouched.

texts.zh: 我们看到一颗理想的星球……一排排工厂和矿场无边无际……没有一寸地表还未得到开发。
texts.en: We see an optimized world... Endless rows of factories and mines... No corner of its surface left untouched.

texts.zh:
在阴沉的黑暗中，有一样东西吸引了我们的注意。毋庸置疑，这是[Root.GetName]的旗帜。

这就是我们吗？
texts.en:
Amid the shadowy murk, one thing catches our attention. Unmistakable and central: it is the flag of [Root.GetName].

Is this us?

label.zh: 把它从我们的回路中擦除。

texts.zh: 景象稍微清晰了一些。我们对自己的观点充满信心。
texts.en: The image sharpens slightly. We are confident in our perception.

texts.zh:
虚境缥缈的浓雾扭曲盘旋，将我们的意识拉入了深处，只留下身躯原地不动。

我们的[GetPsycheLoc]一次次拉伸又收缩，困在重复的潮汐中。每一次有意识的动作都会自我坍缩，张力拉紧，如同被架在台钳上。
texts.en:
The ethereal mists of the Shroud churn and twist, dragging our consciousness deeper whilst our physical forms remain inert, untouched.

Our [GetPsycheLoc] stretches, strains, trapped within a repeating tide. Each attempted movement collapses upon itself, the tension tightening, vice-like in its grip.

texts.zh: 逻辑子历程启动，发现错误：递归循环。我们的灵能处理器无法打破轮回以及恢复功能正常。
texts.en: Logic subroutines engage, the failure is identified: a recursive loop. Our psionic processors are insufficient to break the cycle and resume ordinary function.

texts.zh: 我们看到了过去的自己，身躯被封在一个层层叠叠的立方体中，超出了我们的物理理解。
texts.en: We see past ourselves, our bodies sealed within a cascading tesseract beyond our physical comprehension.

texts.zh: 张力逐渐变得无法承受，我们的形体有溶解在虚空中的危险。一个心声解开了我们的束缚。
texts.en: As the tension becomes unendurable, our forms threaten to dissolve into the void. A voice gouges through our entrapment.

texts.zh: 吞噬！吃光这无尽的虚空！
texts.en: DEVOUR! CONSUME THE ENDLESS VOID!

texts.zh: 超越递归无限的限制！
texts.en: OUTGROW THE CONFINES OF RECURSIVE INFINITY!

texts.zh: 接纳永恒吧！万物归一方得圆满！
texts.en: EMBRACE ETERNITY! ALL IS AS ONE IS AS WHOLE!

texts.zh: 沉溺于无尽的力量吧！
texts.en: INDULGE THE LIMITLESS POTENTIAL!

texts.zh: 那话语和我们自己共鸣着。那势头越来越强，而我们意识到可以将这几乎撕裂我们的混乱平息，只要我们屈从。
texts.en: The words resonate within us. Their momentum builds and we sense a way to quell the disturbance that threatens to tear us asunder, if only we submit.

心声膨胀起来，引导着我们，迫使思绪超越有限的理解。这个循环还在继续——紧缩，又拉得更开——直到撕碎我们的心灵。

我们恳求着虚境中更高力量的引导，帮助我们打破了循环。

然而，并不是所有人都安然无恙。[event_target:shroud_warped_leader.GetName]不在岗了。那心声又回来了。
texts.en:
The voice swells, guiding our actions, forcing our thoughts beyond our limited comprehension. The cycle continues - tightening, pulling us further - before it shatters against our psyche.

We have broken through the recursion, guided by our supplication to the higher powers of the Shroud.

However, not all of us remain. [event_target:shroud_warped_leader.GetName] is no longer at [event_target:shroud_warped_leader.GetHisHer] station. The voice returns.

texts.zh:
我们拒绝了那股强加的躁动。

循环加快，用递归潮汐的力量把我们拖了下去。如果我们停止挣扎，这种张力就不再撕扯我们而是将我们接纳了，让我们短暂地看到了自己之外的东西。

心声又回来了。
texts.en:
We reject the compulsions forced upon us.

The loop quickens, dragging us under with the power of its recursive tide. Once we cease struggling, the tension no longer threatens to break us apart. Instead it subsumes us, allowing us to fleetingly see beyond ourselves.

The voice returns.

texts.zh:
虚境颤抖着，虚弱的扭曲在我们的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]中激荡，一个熟悉的存在显现出来。祂搅动着我们[GetMindPerceptionLoc]的边缘，回响的低语超过了我们的听觉极限。

[from.GetName]回到了我们身边，在难以形容的迷雾中切换着一个个形态。[from.GetHisHer]非常遥远但仍完整，被虚境重塑后渴望着回到岗位。
texts.en:
The Shroud trembles, faint distortions rippling throughout our [GetMindPhysicalLoc] as a familiar presence emerges. It stirs at the edge of our [GetMindPerceptionLoc], whispering echoes just beyond our auditory limits.

[from.GetName] returns to us, phasing through the ineffable mists as they shift into [from.GetHisHer] familiar form. Distant but whole, remade by the Shroud, they are eager to return to duty.

texts.zh:
虚境的浓雾颤抖着散去，露出一盏光洁无瑕的圣杯，里面盛满闪闪发光液体。

我们被莫名的冲动控制，不假思索地向前走。我们开始[GetDrinkLoc]起这杯期待着的液体，而它也开始颤抖起来。

一阵清醒涌上心头。我们[GetImbibeLoc]得越多，这个谎言便愈发昭显。液体开始变稠，一滴滴地在体内凝结。

我们被一种清除体内污秽的冲动征服。
texts.en:
The haze of the Shroud shudders, parting to reveal a chalice brimming with glistening liquid, its surface smooth and unbroken.

A compulsion grips us. We reach forward without thought. The expectant liquid trembles as we begin to [GetDrinkLoc].

Clarity floods through. The more we [GetImbibeLoc], the more the lie reveals itself. The fluid thickens, each drop beginning to curdle inside.

We are overcome with an urge to purge our systems of the contaminate.

texts.zh: 吞下吧！喝掉你的懦弱！
texts.en: GORGE! DROWN YOUR WEAKNESS!

texts.zh: 咽下吧！吸入新的成长！
texts.en: NOURISH! INHALE NEW GROWTHS!

texts.zh: 变强吧！接纳痛苦的联合！
texts.en: STRENGTHEN! EMBRACE PAINFUL UNIFICATION!

texts.zh: 放纵吧！沉溺于你的嗜好！
texts.en: IMBIBE! INDULGE YOUR ADDICTIONS!

texts.zh: 这声音飞旋着与液体融合，在体内不断凝结，让我们屈服于祂的意志。
texts.en: The voice swirls, mixing with the liquid, congealing as it forces its way further inside us, bending our submission to its will.

texts.zh: 征服之人！去战斗吧。
texts.en: CONQUERER! CHAMPION.

texts.zh:
虚境收缩、折叠，将我们的心灵深深地压入一个有限的共鸣虚空中。

一个存在若隐若现，流变而模糊着。随着它将我们与虚境其他部分之间的鸿沟的开合而变化。每一次翕动都释放出一连串的幻景。
texts.en:
The Shroud contracts, folding inwards, pressing our psyche deep within a confined and resonating void.

A presence looms, fluid and indistinct. Its form shifts as it opens and closes the divide that separates us from the rest of the Shroud. Each shuttering reveal unleashes a cascade of visions.

texts.zh: 星球燃烧，被吞噬者的哀号携带着灰烬。每一幅变化的远景都揭示了一场等待被吞噬的盛宴。
texts.en: Worlds burn, their embers carried by the lamentations of the consumed. Each shifting vista reveals a potential feast, ready to be devoured.

texts.zh: 漫山遍野，翠绿的平原上到处都是成群的野生动物。生命的丝缕缠绕、伸展着。每一幅变化的远景都揭示了一个充满变化和塑造潜力的大气。
texts.en: Overflowing landscapes, saturated with wildlife swarming over verdant plains. Threads of life entwine and expand. Each shifting vista reveals a teeming atmosphere of potential to shift and mold.

texts.zh: 社群相互接纳，团结互助，求同存异。每一副变化的远景都揭示了一个新的乌托邦，只欢迎着忠实的人。
texts.en: Communities embracing, uplifting each other in unity at the cost of shunning those who dissent. Each shifting vista reveals a new utopia, welcoming only the faithful.

texts.zh: 宽广的采石场在我们面前伸展开，里面排列着丰厚的资源等待开采。每一幅变化的远景都揭示了一个等待夺取的财富宝库。
texts.en: Vast quarries extend out before us, lined with lucrative resources rife for extraction. Each shifting vista reveals a trove of riches waiting to be plundered.

texts.zh:
每见到一幅新的幻景，我们就会被惯性翻转扭曲，拖向不可能的极速，伴随着现实之墙弯曲起伏。

我们理解了这个大人物的乐趣。祂在考验我们，等待着给吸引我们的那股力量一个称呼。
texts.en:
With each new vision, inertia flips and twists us, dragging us through impossible speeds as the walls of reality bend and ripple.

We sense the figure's amusement. It is testing us, awaiting a name for the force that grips us.

texts.zh: 满足。由征服驱使而来。
texts.en: SATISFACTION. FUELED BY CONQUEST.

我们大声呼喊，那个存在停住了。随着惯性的风暴安定下来变得向量而清晰，千变万化的幻景也停了下来。

我们给出了一个称呼。
texts.en:
Our voice cries out, the presence stills. The shifting visions cease as the tempest of inertia settles into a resounding clarity.

We have named it.

texts.zh: 满足。由征服驱使而来。
texts.en: SATISFACTION. FUELED BY CONQUEST.

texts.zh: 形成。生命缠绕，模式巩固。
texts.en: FORMATION. LIFE ENTWINES, PATTERNS SOLIDIFY.

texts.zh: 和谐。以仁爱规避冲突。
texts.en: HARMONY. DISCORD SHUNNED WITH KINDNESS.

texts.zh: 可为。等待着从寂寥的宇宙撕裂。
texts.en: POTENTIAL. WAITING TO BE TORN FROM THE IDLE COSMOS.

texts.zh: 祂对我们的决定很满意，分开壁垒；随着我们从中浮出，虚空消失了。

texts.zh:
在尝试与[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]交谈时，我们被拽入了虚境的最深层。虚境的这个内层灵域风平浪静。来自每一个轮回的所有思绪的回想都凝聚成了一种洪荒之力。我们听到了永久的流转带来了寂静之声：虚空之低语。

刺耳的不和谐音包围着我们。而我们正努力倾听无数的信息，终于有一个单一的声音传入我们的[GetTelepathPlural]。

倾听是一种奉献。

如果想抽取这份强大的力量，我们必须帮助这个实体占领[GetCovenantPatronColor]的灵域。如此将会把我们超主的已知存在完全替换掉，打破已签订的契约。

这可能会带来很严重的后果。
texts.en:
In our efforts to commune with the [Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName] we are drawn into the deepest layers of the Shroud. In this inner domain, the Shroud turns motionlessly. The reflections of every thought, from every cycle, gather into a primary force. We hear the voices of the voiceless, carried in an ageless churn: the Whisperers in the Void.

A rasping discord surrounds us. We strain to hear their numberless messages, until a singular thought grates through our [GetTelepathPlural].

Listening is a sacrifice.

To draw on this great power, we must assist the entity in occupying the domain of [GetCovenantPatronColor]. Such an act would replace our patron's known presence completely, shattering our established Covenant.

This could lead to significant consequences.

label.zh: 最好不要扰乱虚境的平衡。
label.en: Best not disturb the balance of the Shroud.

texts.zh:
我们的选择刚一做出，[GetTelepathPlural]们就从虚境中暴烈地醒来。他们的脑海中回荡着各种各样的心声。

我们的选择已不可逆转地重塑了对灵能界的认知。随着虚空之低语泄露进的意识，我们现在已经再也感受不到[GetCovenantPatronColor]了；它的灵域对我们而言永久地丧失了。

我们正在逐渐理解低语的意志。我们意识到了祂们关于无尽知识的愿景。只要我们的[GetTelepathPlural]恢复好，我们就可以再次主动行动，与这个无数的存在交流。
texts.en:
As soon as the choice was made, our [GetTelepathPlural] rose from the Shroud in violent wakening. Their minds swam with the echoes of multifarious voices.

Our choice has irrevocably reconfigured our perception of the psionic realm. As the Whisperers in the Void leak into our minds, we can no longer sense [GetCovenantPatronColor] as we once did; its domain is lost to us.

We are slowly comprehending the will of the Whisperers. We sense their vision of limitless knowledge. Once our [GetTelepathPlural] have recovered, we can reach out again and commune with this myriad being.

texts.zh:
自从与世界之喰煞签订契约以来又过了些许时日。我们之间联系的纽带仍旧脆弱，因此仍有将其打破亦或是增强的机会。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]确定，有了这一正式承诺就能主动地利用超主所提供的力量，增强我们的舰队和灵能光环。
texts.en:
Some time has passed since we established the foundation of a Covenant with the the Eater of Worlds. Our bond is still weak, so we still have a chance to break it - or to strengthen it.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] have determined that confirming the pledge will allow us to actively draw on powers provided by our patron, as well as providing enhancements to our fleets and Psionic Aura.

label.en: We will forge our own path.

texts.zh:
我们刚一跃入虚境，一个存在就主动找了上来。祂的思想在我们[GetTelepathPlural]的回路中纠结缠绕，软磨硬泡，讨价还价。这是渴求之器具，祂将赐予我们财富、力量、威望……一切我们渴望的事物。一切我们将渴望的事物。

代价？小意思，不过是一笔服务费。祂一心为我们好，祂将帮助我们、指导我们，引导我们的野心和梦想。

只要我们将祂纳入我们的心灵。

它很确信我们会答应，我们怎么可能会不答应呢？
texts.en:
As soon as we plunge into the Shroud, a presence reaches out for us. Its thoughts coil and twist themselves around the circuits of our [GetTelepathPlural], bargaining, cajoling. It is the Instrument of Desire and it will grant us wealth, power, prestige... all that we have ever desired. All that we will ever desire.

The cost? A small matter, little more than a cover fee. It only wants what is best for us. It will help us, guide us, direct our ambitions and dreams.

If we will only accept it into our mainframes.

It is confident that we will say yes. How could we possibly not say yes?

label.en: We will forge our own path.

texts.zh:
一个存在在虚境中等待着，亲切地欢迎我们。祂不费言辞，而是以幻景、概念和想法来表达。祂滑入我们[GetTelepathPlural]的回路中，温柔而丝滑，宛如一开始便在一般。一连串的画面在他们面前闪过。

这个存在即是生命之织缕，祂认为我们的有机形态具有有趣的性质。祂展示了许多我们的身躯可以加以适应、变化、改进、演化的方向。

只要我们愿意将其纳入组成。

祂耐心而亲切地等待着回答，就像温柔的父母等待着最亲爱的孩子一般。
texts.en:
A presence awaits us in the Shroud, welcoming us with genial familiarity. It speaks not so much in words but in visions, concepts, ideas. It seeps into the circuits of our [GetTelepathPlural], so gently and smoothly that one might think it had always been there. A flurry of images flash before them.

This presence, the Composer of Strands, regards our mechanical forms with curious interest. It shows us a variety of ways in which they can be adapted, changed. Improved. Upgraded.

If we will only take it into our components.

It waits for our answer patiently, affectionately. Like a doting parent waiting on their favorite child.

This is a small sacrifice for our newfound bond. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], the Composer's greatest blessings are yet to come.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] have determined that confirming the pledge will allow us to actively draw on powers provided by our patron, as well as providing enhancements to our fleets and Psionic Aura.

label.en: Renounce the Whisperers in the Void.
We will forge our own path.

texts.zh:
低语尖锐地变化着，祂们的声音覆盖了脑海中的一切。祂们渴望与我们交流，向我们灌输知识。

我们必须做出不可改变的选择。
texts.en:
The Whisperers shift piercingly, their voices obscuring all else within our minds. They are eager to commune with us, to crowd our minds with knowledge.

We have an irrevocable choice to make.

texts.zh:
随着[GetTelepathPlural]们浮出虚境，我们发现自己的背叛引来了[GetBetrayedPatronColour]的强力反噬。

[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName]附近出现了一道虚境隧道，而它现在也变成了一片无尽废墟的荒芜。我们在隧道的另一头[GetFeltLoc]到了显而易见的愤怒；前超主毫无疑问正在准备复仇。
texts.en:
As our [GetTelepathPlural] emerged from the Shroud, we discovered that our betrayal had caused a powerful backlash from [GetBetrayedPatronColour].

A Shroud Tunnel has emerged near [event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.GetName], which is now a world of endless wastes. We have [GetFeltLoc] a palpable fury beyond the tunnel; our former patron is no doubt preparing its revenge.

label.zh: 我们必须做好自卫的准备。
label.en: We must prepare to defend ourselves.

texts.zh: 一个灵能化身从[event_target:spawn_system.GetName]恒星系的虚境隧道上出现。这是[GetBetrayedPatronColour]之怒的显化，现在正向[capital_scope.GetName]袭来。
texts.en: A Psionic Avatar has emerged from the Shroud Tunnel in the [event_target:spawn_system.GetName] system. A manifestation of the wrath of [GetBetrayedPatronColour], it is now traveling in the direction of [capital_scope.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们成功地召集了力量反击出现的威胁。我们的舰船向虚境隧道中放出灵能能量波，在敌意实体穿入本现实时削弱了它。
texts.en: We were successful in gathering our forces against the emerging threat. Our ships emitted waves of psionic energy into the Shroud Tunnel, weakening the hostile entity as it breached into our reality.

texts.zh:
我们与一位名为世界之喰煞的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着贪婪的感觉，它索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]总结道，如果与我们的超主保持一致，这条纽带可以被加强。

喰煞无厌而饥渴。祂渴望战争、以及冲突和哀嚎的甜美。
texts.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the Eater of Worlds. Insatiable, it grants us crumbs of its power for a price.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Eater hungers impatiently. It craves war, the sweet taste of strife and lament.

texts.zh:
我们与一位名为魂灵之月窠的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着和谐的感觉，它索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]总结道，如果与我们的超主保持一致，这条纽带可以被加强。

月窠渴求着星系摆脱混沌和冲突，所有住民都致力于实现同一个和平。只有完美的平衡才足够。
texts.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the Cradle of Souls. Harmonious, it grants us crumbs of power for a price.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Cradle aches for a galaxy free from chaos and conflict, with all its denizens bent towards the unifying goal of peace. Only perfect balance will suffice.

我们与一位名为生命之织缕的虚境实体建立了纽带。伴随着荫蔽的感觉，祂索取一定代价赐予我们零星力量。这样的交换应该还会有更多。

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]推论，只看我们的行为与超主的意志相调和，这条纽带就会进一步加强。

织缕渴求基因操控和将血肉从进化的桎梏中解脱。祂教导我们对敬畏生命和自然，以及血肉的神圣性。
texts.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the Composer of Strands. Sheltering, it grants us crumbs of its power for a price. There will likely be more to follow.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be further deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Composer yearns for genetic manipulations and flesh set free from the constraints of evolution. It tells us about respect for life and nature, and the sanctity of the flesh.

The Instrument longs for yearning. Indulged pleasures, decadence, and slavery spell the name of the Instrument.

我们的[GetTelepathPlural]总结道，如果将我们的行为与超主保持一致，这条纽带将更容易被加强。

低语享受新的知识、沉默的秘密和阴谋。祂们陶醉于一种简单的快乐，这种快乐充满了头脑，在接缝处开裂。
texts.en:
We have created a bond with a Shroud entity named the Whisperers in the Void. Unfathomable, it promises to grant us crumbs of power for a price.

Our [GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the bond can be deepened by aligning our actions with the will of our patron.

The Whisperers enjoy new knowledge, silent secrets, and conspiracies. They revel in the simple joy of a mind filled to the brim, cracking at the seams.

我们正在召集精英灵能使集会，准备向虚境深处进军，与其中力量庞大的势力交流。

在知道这个实体的真名之前，我们会称之为[Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName]。
texts.en:
We are gathering a convocation of elite telepaths, ready to reach deep into the Shroud and commune with a force of immense power.

Until we know its true name, this being shall be referred to as the [Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName].

texts.zh:
世界之喰煞向我们释放出了暴怒。虚境隧道在[event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.solar_system.GetName]恒星系现身，我们的[GetTelepathPlural]能[GetFeelLoc]到我们前超主的怨恨正在快速袭来。

我们必须做好自我保护的准备。
texts.en:
The Eater of Worlds has unleashed its furious wrath upon us. A Shroud Tunnel has emerged in the [event_target:selected_planet_for_revenge.solar_system.GetName] system, and our [GetTelepathPlural] can [GetFeelLoc] the fast-approaching malice of our former patron.

We must prepare to defend ourselves.
